verdict.rationale: Google Cloud has an official public pricing calculator for adding and configuring products to build a shareable cost estimate before committing (docs-14). Its free program publicly lists the $300 new-customer credit, per-product free usage limits, and that you aren't charged until you activate a paid account (docs-12, docs-13, docs-31). Missing for 10: direct evidence of public per-service pricing pages (rate cards), and independent or hands-on corroboration that calculator estimates match real bills.
